preview.text: India Champions play West Indies Champions in a T20 match at Sharjah Cricket Stadium, where the usual first-innings score in the 82 recorded T20 matches is 153. West Indies Champions won the toss and chose to bowl first. The forecast for the next 8 hours predicts up to a 0 per cent chance of rain and about 28 degrees.

summary.text: INDCH scored 110-8 in their innings with Rishi Dhawan top-scoring at 34 off 32 balls while Rayad Emrit took 2 for 24. WICH replied with 111-4 as Chadwick Walton scored 60 off 43 balls, securing a six-wicket victory despite Dhawal Kulkarni taking 2 for 21.
